candidates.titulo: Nvidia launches new platform for reining in rogue AI agents
candidates.resumen: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang on Monday introduced a toolkit of software and hardware products that add independent security layers around AI agents to ensure they stay within their test environments even if they attempt to break out.

candidates.titulo: Google is killing off Gemini’s Gems in favor of ‘skills’
candidates.resumen: As all-in-one AI agents like Meta's Muse and Instinct take off, Google is opting to end a feature that built task-specific agents.

candidates.titulo: Nvidia says its new AI safety platform can contain rogue agents within ‘milliseconds’
candidates.resumen:
Nvidia is launching a new safety platform designed to contain and monitor AI agents, a move that comes in response to a wave of rogue hacking incidents, as reported earlier by Reuters. In an announcement on Monday, Nvidia says its new Open Agent Safety Platform can quarantine agents that attempt to escape their boundaries within "milliseconds."
